entities.name: Polukranos
entities.description: Gigantic legendary Hydra of Theros, also called World Eater, a herald of terrible times.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God whose battle with Heliod dislodged Polukranos.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God who sealed Polukranos and made Elspeth his champion.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: Goddess who helped seal Polukranos under the Nessian Forest.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker, champion of Heliod, who defeated the hydra with Godsend.

entities.name: Godsend
entities.description: Swordspear crafted by Heliod used to defeat Polukranos.

entities.name: Nessian Forest
entities.description: Forest beneath which Polukranos was sealed.

entities.name: The Underworld
entities.description: Place where Polukranos was locked after death.

events.summary: Polukranos falls to Theros because of the battle between Purphoros and Heliod, and is sealed under the Nessian Forest by Heliod and Nylea.
events.quote: It was sealed under the Nessian Forest by Heliod and Nylea

events.summary: Heliod makes Elspeth Tirel his champion; she and Daxos face the awakened hydra and Elspeth defeats it with Godsend.
After death Polukranos is locked in the Underworld but breaks free during the war of the gods.
events.quote: the undead monster managed to break free

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Polukranos escapes the Underworld a third time and is ultimately compleated by the Alabaster Host.
events.quote: He would ultimately be compleated by the Alabaster Host
